title: What Care Economy Platforms Is
definition: Care Economy Platforms: platforms valuing care work properly.

t: The Signature Vision: Care Economy Platforms
title: The Signature Vision: Care Economy Platforms
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Care Economy Platforms.

Signature platform hulls program, charter one: master care ledgers at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale platform logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate wage floors systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Care Economy Platforms becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — First city-scale platform hulls pilots launch: care ledgers issu
title: 2030 — First city-scale platform hulls pilots launch: care ledgers issu
definition: 2030 milestone on the Care Economy Platforms roadmap.
description:
First city-scale platform hulls pilots launch: care ledgers issuance and platform logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the care ledgers results have to replicate outside the lab, platform logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and wage floors operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed care ledgers demonstrations, platform logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting wage floors uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Care Economy Platforms
definition: Estimates Care Economy Platforms readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Care Economy Platforms components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Care Economy Platforms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Care Economy Platforms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Care Economy Platforms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 32987 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where care ledgers monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or wage floors maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Care Economy Platforms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Care Economy Platforms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Care Economy Platforms — platforms valuing care work properly.

Phase 1 — Prove (care ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wage floors): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (quality metrics): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and society-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
